articles.title_en: The pharmacist will see you now: Pharmacist prescribed contraceptives and fertility rates
articles.title_cn: 药剂师现在会见您：药剂师开出避孕药具和生育率
articles.abstract_en: Policies that increase contraceptive access for young women and their partners are a potentially low-cost way of reducing unintended pregnancies and improving later life outcomes. Several states have recently implemented laws that allow pharmacists to prescribe contraceptives to women without the need to see a physician. We study the effect of these state laws on fertility rates. Using US Natality files for 2014–2020, we employ a difference-in-differences strategy using the 13 states that had enacted a law until the first quarter of 2020 as the treated group, and the 15 policy-implementing states post-2020 quarter 1 as the control group. We find approximately 0.5 fewer births per 1000 women aged 15–49 per quarter occur post law implementation, compared to control states. The effect of the policy appears to be focused among women aged 25–34 and 40–44 and women with a high school education or less.
articles.abstract_cn: 增加年轻女性及其伴侣获得避孕药具的政策可能是减少意外怀孕和改善晚年生活结果的低成本方法。几个州最近实施了法律，允许药剂师为女性开避孕药具，而无需看医生。我们研究这些州法律对生育率的影响。使用2014-2020的美国出生率文件，我们采用双重差分策略，将2020第一季度之前颁布法律的13州作为处理组，将2020季度1之后的15政策实施州作为对照组。我们发现，与对照州相比，法律实施后，每季度 15-49 岁 1000 名妇女的生育率大约减少 0.5 人。该政策的效果似乎集中在25-34岁和40-44岁的女性以及高中及以下学历的女性中。

articles.title_en: Is supported employment effective for Disability Insurance recipients with mental health conditions? Evidence from a randomized experiment in Belgium
articles.title_cn: 支持性就业对患有心理健康问题的残疾保险受益人是否有效？来自比利时随机实验的证据
articles.abstract_en: We conduct a randomized experiment (n = 600) to evaluate a Supported Employment (SE) program that, through intensive job coaching and follow-along support, aims to increase work activity of Belgian Disability Insurance (DI) recipients with mental health conditions. The control group gets regular vocational rehabilitation. After a 30-month follow-up period, we find that SE increases the probability of working while claiming DI by 7.5 percentage points and reduces the amount of DI benefit received by 110 euros per month (−9.5 percent).
articles.abstract_cn: 我们进行了一项随机实验（n = 600），以评估支持性就业（SE）项目，该项目通过密集的工作指导和后续支持，旨在增加患有心理健康问题的比利时残疾保险（DI）受益人的工作活动。对照组接受常规的职业康复。经过30个月的随访期，我们发现SE使在领取DI的同时工作的概率提高了7.5个百分点，并将每月领取的DI福利金额减少了110欧元（−9.5%）。

articles.title_en: Intensive care supply and admission decisions
articles.title_cn: 重症监护供给与入院决策
articles.abstract_en: Over 2005–2019, the number of neonatal intensive care units (NICUs) grew by 10%, and the number of NICU beds increased by 30%. This expansion in intensive care has raised concerns over unwarranted intensive care admissions. In this study, we examine whether the greater supply of NICUs causally raises admission rates. Our event-study results show that an additional NICU opening in a county raises the share of newborns admitted to the NICU by 8%. The majority of new NICU admissions come from healthier newborns (2,500 grams and over) rather than very premature newborns (<1,500 grams). Admission for the smallest newborns (those under 1,500 grams) only increases in counties with limited NICU access. In these areas, greater NICU supply also reduces mortality, but only for very small newborns (<1,500 grams). Together, our findings suggest a tradeoff, where higher NICU supply reduces neonatal mortality for the most vulnerable infants while also raising admission for healthier newborns.
articles.abstract_cn: 在2005-2019年间，新生儿重症监护病房（NICU）的数量增长了10%，NICU床位数量增加了30%。重症监护的扩张引发了对于不必要的重症监护入院的担忧。在本研究中，我们考察了NICU供给的增加是否因果性地提高了入院率。我们的事件研究结果显示，一个县每新增一个NICU，新生儿入住NICU的比例提高8%。新增NICU入院主要来自更健康的新生儿（体重2500克及以上），而非极早产儿（体重低于1500克）。对于最小新生儿（体重低于1500克）的入院仅在NICU可及性有限的县有所增加。在这些地区，更大的NICU供给也降低了死亡率，但仅限于极小新生儿（体重低于1500克）。综合来看，我们的发现表明存在一种权衡：更高的NICU供给降低了最脆弱婴儿的新生儿死亡率，同时也提高了更健康新生儿的入院率。

articles.title_en: Investigator racial diversity and clinical trial participation
articles.title_cn: 研究者种族多样性与临床试验参与
articles.abstract_en: We investigate whether increased racial diversity of clinical trial principal investigators could increase the enrollment of Black patients, which currently lags population and disease-burden. We conducted a survey experiment in which respondents were shown a photo of a current NIH investigator in which race (Black/White) was randomized. Sex was also randomized as a relevant benchmark. Black respondents reported 0.35 standard deviation units higher interest in participating in a clinical study led by a race concordant investigator (a 12.6% increase). Sex concordance had no effect. Further analyses indicate that perceived trustworthiness and attractiveness are the most important factors explaining these results.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们调查了临床试验主要研究者的种族多样性增加是否能提高黑人患者的入组率，目前这一比例落后于人口和疾病负担。我们进行了一项调查实验，其中受访者被展示了一张当前NIH研究者的照片，其种族（黑人/白人）是随机分配的。性别也作为相关基准进行了随机分配。黑人受访者报告称，在由种族一致的研究者领导的临床研究中，参与兴趣高出0.35个标准差单位（增加12.6%）。性别一致性没有影响。进一步分析表明，感知的可信度和吸引力是解释这些结果的最重要因素。

articles.title_en: The effect of smoking cessation on mental health: Evidence from a randomized trial
articles.title_cn: 戒烟对心理健康的影响：来自随机试验的证据
articles.abstract_en: One in nine Americans smokes cigarettes, and a disproportionate share of smokers suffer from mental illness. Despite this correlation, there exists little rigorous evidence on the effects of smoking cessation on mental health. We re-use data from a randomized trial of a smoking cessation treatment to estimate short and long-term impacts on previously un-analyzed measures of mental distress. We find that smoking cessation increases short-run mental distress, while reducing milder forms of long-run distress. We provide suggestive evidence on mechanisms including physical health, marriage, employment and substance use. Our results suggest that cessation efforts and mental health supports are complementary interventions in the short run and provide new evidence of welfare gains from cessation in the long run.
articles.abstract_cn: 每九个美国人中就有一人吸烟，且吸烟者中患有精神疾病的比例不成比例地高。尽管存在这种相关性，但关于戒烟对心理健康影响的严谨证据却很少。我们重新使用了戒烟治疗随机试验的数据，以估计对先前未分析的心理困扰指标的短期和长期影响。我们发现，戒烟增加了短期心理困扰，同时减少了长期较轻形式的困扰。我们提供了关于身体健状况、婚姻、就业和物质使用等机制的提示性证据。我们的结果表明，戒烟努力和心理健康支持在短期内是互补的干预措施，并为长期戒烟带来的福利收益提供了新证据。

articles.title_en: Income receipt, economic activities, and health: Evidence from ambulance transport patterns
articles.title_cn: 收入领取、经济活动与健康：来自救护车转运模式的证据
articles.abstract_en: Studies indicate that mortality increases after income receipt. To explore whether this is due to increased economic activity around the period of receiving income, we examine within-month patterns in ambulance transport incidents, focusing on location and timing. Using Japan’s National Pension payments made every two months, we compare the number of ambulance transport incidents on the day of pension payment and on surrounding days in payment months with those in non-payment months. The results show a 4.5% increase in ambulance transport incidents on the day of pension payment, linked to increased activities such as gambling, shopping, and dining out. We show suggestive evidence that income receipt boosts economic activities by the mechanism of easing liquidity constraints. These findings have implications for healthcare system preparedness and the optimal design of public benefit payment.
articles.abstract_cn: 研究表明，收入领取后死亡率上升。为探讨这是否源于收入领取期间经济活动的增加，我们考察了救护车转运事件在月内的模式，重点关注地点和时间。利用日本每两个月支付一次的国民养老金，我们比较了养老金支付日及支付月份周边日子的救护车转运事件数量与非支付月份的情况。结果显示，养老金支付日救护车转运事件增加了4.5%，这与赌博、购物和外出就餐等活动的增加有关。我们提供了提示性证据，表明收入领取通过缓解流动性约束的机制促进了经济活动。这些发现对医疗系统的准备和公共福利支付的最优设计具有启示意义。

articles.title_en: Implications of the decline in LGBT rights for population mental health: Evidence from Polish “LGBT-free zones”
articles.title_cn: LGBT权利下降对人口心理健康的影响：来自波兰“无LGBT区域”的证据
articles.abstract_en: Theories of minority stress suggest recent legislation limiting LGBT rights can reduce the health of LGBT individuals and their families. We investigate how the creation of LGBT-free zones across Poland during 2019 and 2020 affected mental health and mortality. We find that annual suicide attempts increased by 16.5 %, or 5 attempts per 100k, deaths from external causes, including automobile accidents, suicides and other accidents and injuries increased 10.6 %, or 5.6 deaths per 100k, and suicide deaths increased 17.0 % (p = 0.108), or 1.9 deaths per 100k, in LGBT-free zones. The rise in suicide attempts was concentrated among individuals aged 13–18 and 45–49 and coincided with an 8.8 % increase in sales of prescription drugs for addictive disorders. However, there was no change in the use of psychotropic medications used to treat mental health conditions, indicative of limited access to mental health care.
articles.abstract_cn: 少数群体压力理论认为，近期限制LGBT权利的立法可能会降低LGBT个体及其家人的健康。我们调查了2019年和2020年期间波兰各地创建无LGBT区域如何影响心理健康和死亡率。我们发现，在无LGBT区域，年度自杀未遂增加了16.5 %，即每100k人增加5次；外部原因导致的死亡（包括车祸、自杀及其他事故和伤害）增加了10.6 %，即每100k人增加5.6例；自杀死亡增加了17.0 %（p = 0.108），即每100k人增加1.9例。自杀未遂的增加集中在13-18岁和45-49岁的人群中，并且与成瘾障碍处方药销售增加8.8 %同时发生。然而，用于治疗心理健康状况的精神药物使用没有变化，这表明心理健康护理的可及性有限。
